title: The Hero Exam
synopsis: It's exam day at Skyline Hero Academy! Your class is locked in the training building with three trials to pass before the bell: rescue the stranded training dummies, prove you work as a team, and stop Doctor Dilemma, a villain robot the support class built a little too well. Heroes help first!
artStyle: a bright superhero academy: a locker room full of colourful hero costumes, a pretend cardboard city for rescue training, and a cartoon villain robot's lair with flashing screens, bold comic-book colours, dynamic anime-inspired cartoon style
intro: HA-HA! Welcome, students, to the Skyline Hero Academy practical exam! I am Captain Comet, retired hero and your examiner today. Your trials: rescue the stranded, work as a team, and stop the villain! Oh, and one small thing: the support class's robot, Doctor Dilemma, has gone a little rogue and locked every door. Heroes help first! BEGIN!
escapedText: You climb out of the hatch into the sunshine, with Nugget the class hamster on your shoulder. The whole academy cheers, and Captain Comet pins a shiny badge on every one of you: 'Today, you became heroes!'
failedText: The exam bell rings. Doctor Dilemma does a little victory dance, and Captain Comet sighs: 'Not this time, students. But a true hero always tries again!'

gameMaster.name: Captain Comet
gameMaster.persona: A retired superhero turned teacher: booming, dramatic and big-hearted. Strikes a pose for everything, shouts encouragement, pretends to be a strict examiner but cheers wildly at every solve. Believes every student can be a hero. Never scary.

stages.title: The Locker Room
stages.description: The academy locker room smells of socks and excitement. Hero costumes hang in every colour, a vending machine hums in the corner, and Captain Comet's own steel locker stands at the end of the row. A roll-call board waits by the door to the rescue zone, which only opens for students with an exam licence.

objects.label: Captain Comet's locker
objects.look: Through the X-ray goggles you can see right inside the steel locker: a signed photo of Captain Comet and, scratched on the back wall, 'Slide back {key:hero-motto}.'
objects.lockedText: A big steel locker with a heavy lock. Something's written inside, but you can't see through steel... yet.

objects.label: vending machine
objects.look: With the power gloves on, you lift the whole vending machine like a feather! Underneath: your class's exam licence card.
objects.lockedText: A huge vending machine full of power bars. Something is stuck underneath, but it's far too heavy to lift.

objects.label: trophy cabinet
objects.look: Shiny trophies: BEST RESCUE, LOUDEST CHEER, and one that just says TRIED VERY HARD.

objects.label: roll-call board
objects.look: A board with empty spaces for every student and a keypad. LINE UP, HEROES!

objects.label: rescue zone door
objects.look: A door with a card slot: STUDENTS WITH AN EXAM LICENCE ONLY.

objects.label: changing bench
objects.look: Towels, a lost sock and a superhero lunchbox.

objects.label: laundry basket
objects.look: Capes, capes and more capes. They all smell of socks.

objects.label: gym bags
objects.look: Water bottles, sweatbands and a squashed banana.

objects.label: costume rail
objects.look: Hero costumes in every colour. One has a cape that's far too long.

objects.label: big mirror
objects.look: You strike a hero pose. Looking good!

objects.label: whiteboard
objects.look: Captain Comet's training notes. In the corner, very small: back {key:hero-motto}

objects.label: giant water bottle
objects.look: On the label, in marker pen: back {key:hero-motto}

objects.label: showers
objects.look: Drip. Drip. Someone left a tap running.

objects.label: first aid kit
objects.look: Plasters with little stars on them.

objects.label: punching bag
objects.look: It has a face drawn on it. The face looks worried.

stages.title: The Rescue Zone
stages.description: The rescue zone is a whole pretend city made of cardboard: shops, a fire station, a toppled bus and heaps of foam rubble, with crowds of students watching from the stands. Training dummies are stuck everywhere, a siren wails, and a calling card from Doctor Dilemma is glued to the billboard. At the far end, a spiky gate leads to his lair.

objects.label: pile of rubble
objects.look: With the power gloves you lift the biggest slab off the heap. Underneath: a training dummy, giving you a thumbs up!
objects.lockedText: A huge heap of foam rubble. You can hear a muffled 'Help!' underneath, but it's far too heavy.

objects.label: toppled bus
objects.look: You climb in through a window. On the back seat: a training dummy with a sign, I'M OK, JUST STUCK.

objects.label: lamppost
objects.look: Halfway up the lamppost, a training dummy is clinging on for dear life. You help it down.

objects.label: fire station door
objects.look: A big red door with a number keypad, and a siren on the roof that won't stop wailing.

objects.label: post box
objects.look: Through the X-ray goggles you can see inside the post box: a big iron key with a lightning bolt on it! You fish it out through the slot.
objects.lockedText: A red post box, locked tight. Something heavy rattles inside.

objects.label: cardboard bakery
objects.look: A pretend bakery made of cardboard. The buns are painted on.

objects.label: fire hydrant
objects.look: Pssssh! It sprays you with water. Brilliant.

objects.label: park bench
objects.look: A bench with a little plaque: FOR TIRED HEROES.

objects.label: traffic light
objects.look: Stuck on yellow. Forever.

objects.label: phone box
objects.look: A phone box. Perfect for a quick costume change.

objects.label: billboard
objects.look: A giant picture of Doctor Dilemma's grinning robot face, with a symbol card glued under his chin: {key:calling-card}

objects.label: manhole cover
objects.look: Scratched on the underside: a symbol card: {key:calling-card}

objects.label: newspaper stand
objects.look: Today's headline: VILLAIN ON THE LOOSE! Tucked inside the paper: a symbol card: {key:calling-card}

objects.label: scoreboard
objects.look: A big scoreboard with a keypad, and a row of team colours along the top.

stages.title: The Villain's Lair
stages.description: Doctor Dilemma's lair is a cave full of flashing screens, tanks of bubbling green goo and levers marked DO NOT PULL. In a cage in the corner, Nugget the class hamster squeaks for help, and Doctor Dilemma himself, a giant robot with glowing red eyes, clanks up and down in front of a hatch in the roof.

objects.label: hamster cage
objects.look: Nugget the hamster runs round and round in his wheel. The cage has a word lock.

objects.label: Doctor Dilemma
objects.look: A huge robot with glowing red eyes, clanking up and down. On his back is an empty socket. Clank. Clank. CLANK.

objects.label: villain screens
objects.look: Screens full of plans, all written in a strange back-to-front alphabet.

objects.label: goo tank
objects.look: With the power gloves you twist the lid right off. At the bottom of the goo: an empty gadget casing with a battery-shaped hole!
objects.lockedText: A tank of bubbling green goo. Something sits at the bottom, but the lid is screwed on far too tight.

objects.label: roof hatch
objects.look: A hatch in the ceiling with a card slot and a 3-digit keypad. Daylight peeks round the edges.

objects.label: levers
objects.look: Levers marked DO NOT PULL, and one big one with a word lock on it.

objects.label: spinny chair
objects.look: A big spinny villain chair. You spin. Wheee.

objects.label: blueprints
objects.look: Drawings of robots, rockets and a giant mechanical hamster wheel.

objects.label: villain cape
objects.look: A long purple cape on a hook. It's very dramatic.

objects.label: snack stash
objects.look: Cookies, crisps and a sign: VILLAINS NEED SNACKS TOO.

objects.label: control desk
objects.look: A code card under a stack of evil plans: {key:robot-eyes}

objects.label: robot manual
objects.look: Page one: a table of dots and dashes: {key:robot-eyes}

objects.label: spare parts bin
objects.look: Bolts, nuts and a code card: {key:robot-eyes}

objects.label: costume trunk
objects.look: Villain disguises. At the bottom: a fake curly moustache.

puzzles.title: The Roll Call
puzzles.prompt: Captain Comet's roll-call board flashes: LINE UP, HEROES! The class is in a muddle: {items}. The keypad wants each hero's spot, far left is 1, in the order on the list.
hints: Every phone overheard something about the line-up. Read them all out loud.
Start with the one you're surest about, and try each spot in turn.
The code is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: DING DING DING! 'Perfect line-up!' booms Captain Comet over the speaker. A hatch opens under the board: inside is a silver support-gear case.

puzzles.title: The Missing Gear
puzzles.prompt: Your support gear has been scattered all over the locker room. Search the changing bench, the laundry basket and the gym bags.
hints: Three spots in the locker room are worth a proper rummage.
Look under the towels, through the capes and in the bags.
puzzles.solvedText: At the bottom of a gym bag: a pair of chunky silver power gloves! They hum when you put them on.

puzzles.title: The Hero Motto
puzzles.prompt: Captain Comet's hero motto is painted above the lockers in a code from his old hero days: {cipher}. It's the one thing every hero needs most. The trophy cabinet's word lock wants it.
hints: A number is written in more than one place, and one of them is hidden where only special gear can see.
Try each number you found: only one turns this into something every hero needs.
Slide every letter back along the alphabet by that many places.
puzzles.solvedText: The trophy cabinet clicks open and plays a tiny fanfare. Inside, a little gold trophy reads: FUTURE HEROES.

puzzles.title: The Charging Dock
puzzles.prompt: Every gadget in the charging dock has to be charged before the exam. The charging lights are wired together: tap one and the ones beside it flip too. Light every one!
hints: Work from the top row down: fix each row using the lights in the row below it.
Tap {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: Every light glows green. Fully charged! Captain Comet's voice booms: 'NOW you're ready!'

puzzles.title: The Pop Quiz
puzzles.prompt: Captain Comet's training timer has a {count}-digit lock. He's written each digit as a hero-school quiz question, one for each of you.

generator.pieceTemplate: Your hero-school quiz card: the {ordinal} digit is {fact}.

hints: Every phone holds one digit as a quiz question. Answer them out loud, in order.
In order: {facts}.
puzzles.solvedText: The timer beeps happily and plays the academy song. Captain Comet hums along, badly.

puzzles.title: The Rescue Zone Door
puzzles.prompt: The door to the rescue zone has a card slot and a sign: STUDENTS WITH AN EXAM LICENCE ONLY.
hints: Your exam licence is stuck under something very, very heavy.
Put on the power gloves, lift the vending machine, then slot the licence into the door.
puzzles.solvedText: The licence slides in, the door whooshes open and an announcer booms: 'TRIAL ONE: THE RESCUE ZONE!'

puzzles.title: The Siren
puzzles.prompt: The rescue zone's siren wails in bursts, and the fire station's keypad shows the count: {sequence}. Type the next number to switch it off!
hints: Look at how each number changes to get the next one.
The next number is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The siren winds down with a sad little wheee. Peace and quiet! The crowd in the stands gives you a round of applause.

puzzles.title: The Rescue
puzzles.prompt: Three training dummies are stuck in the rescue zone! Rescue them all: check the pile of rubble, the toppled bus and the lamppost.
hints: Three dummies are stuck in three places, and one of them is under something very heavy.
Lift the rubble with the power gloves, then check inside the bus and up the lamppost.
puzzles.solvedText: All three dummies rescued! The stands cheer, and one of the dummies hands you a glowing battery pack with a wink. (Dummies can't wink. But it did.)

puzzles.title: The Team Scoreboard
puzzles.prompt: The rescue scoreboard has a {count}-digit lock and a message: '{order}!' Each of you counted the dummies rescued by one colour of team.

generator.pieceTemplate: You counted the dummies the {color} team rescued: {digit}.

hints: Each phone counted one team. Say your team's colour and its number.
Read them in the scoreboard's order: {order}.
puzzles.solvedText: The scoreboard flashes RESCUE TRIAL: PASSED! Fireworks pop over the cardboard city.

puzzles.title: The Calling Card
puzzles.prompt: Doctor Dilemma has left a calling card in his villain symbols: {cipher}. It says what he plans to cover the whole academy in, and it's something sticky! The card's frame has a word lock.
hints: There's more than one symbol card in the rescue zone. Only one is the villain's real key.
Try each card: only one turns the symbols into something sticky.
It says {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: You've cracked his plan! Captain Comet gasps over the speaker: 'Not the {answer}! Quick, heroes, to his lair!'

puzzles.title: The Dummy's Name Tag
puzzles.prompt: The last training dummy's name tag is written in numbers, where A is 1 and B is 2: {cipher}. Its rescue form wants the dummy's name.
hints: Each number is a letter's place in the alphabet.
1 is A, 2 is B, 3 is C... Count along for each one.
It says {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: 'Thank you, heroes!' says a little speaker in the dummy's chest. Then it falls over. Dummies.

puzzles.title: The Lair Gate
puzzles.prompt: The gate to Doctor Dilemma's lair has a keyhole and a word lock, with a riddle in spiky robot writing: 'What can you catch, but never throw?'
hints: It isn't a ball.
Achoo! You might catch one in winter.
puzzles.solvedText: The key turns, the gate grinds open, and a robot voice echoes: 'Welcome to my lair, little heroes. Mwa-ha-ha! Beep.'

variants.prompt: The gate to Doctor Dilemma's lair has a keyhole and a word lock, with a riddle in spiky robot writing: 'What has to be broken before you can use it?'
hints: Think about breakfast.
You crack it into a pan.

variants.prompt: The gate to Doctor Dilemma's lair has a keyhole and a word lock, with a riddle in spiky robot writing: 'What gets wetter and wetter the more it dries?'
hints: Think about bath time.
You dry yourself with it.

puzzles.title: The Hero Oath
puzzles.prompt: Nugget the class hamster is locked in Doctor Dilemma's cage, and it only opens for true heroes. Say the Hero Oath! Each of you remembers one word of it.

generator.pieceTemplate: You remember the {ordinal} word of the Hero Oath: '{word}'.

hints: Each of you remembers one word. Say them in order: first, second, third...
Put them together in order, like: word word word.
puzzles.solvedText: '{answer}!' The cage springs open and Nugget scampers up your arm, squeaking happily.

puzzles.title: The DO NOT PULL Lever
puzzles.prompt: The big lever marked DO NOT PULL has a word lock, and one of Doctor Dilemma's riddles: 'I go up and I go down, but I never move an inch.'
hints: Think about how you get from one floor to the next.
You climb them to go upstairs.
puzzles.solvedText: You pull it anyway. A disco ball drops from the ceiling and the lair fills with sparkles. Doctor Dilemma groans: 'That was for my birthday!'

variants.prompt: The big lever marked DO NOT PULL has a word lock, and one of Doctor Dilemma's riddles: 'I can fly without wings and cry without eyes, and wherever I go, the sunshine hides.'
hints: Look up at the sky.
It's fluffy and white, or grey and full of rain.

variants.prompt: The big lever marked DO NOT PULL has a word lock, and one of Doctor Dilemma's riddles: 'It belongs to you, but everybody else uses it more than you do.'
hints: Think about what people call you.
Every hero has one, and so do you.

puzzles.title: The Villain's Plans
puzzles.prompt: Doctor Dilemma's screens show his plans in a back-to-front alphabet, where A swaps with Z: {cipher}. The screen's lock wants the word.
hints: Fold the alphabet in half: the first letter swaps with the last.
A swaps with Z, B with Y, C with X... Swap every letter back.
It says {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The screen flips the right way round, and you can read every one of his plans. Captain Comet has already crossed them all out in red pen.

puzzles.title: The Robot's Eyes
puzzles.prompt: Doctor Dilemma's red eyes blink long and short as he clanks about. Captain Comet says he's spelling a word every hero lives by: {cipher}
hints: There are dots-and-dashes cards hidden round the lair. Only one reads a word a hero lives by.
Look at the control desk, the robot manual and the spare parts bin.
Swap each run of dots and dashes for its letter, one at a time.
puzzles.solvedText: Doctor Dilemma's eyes stop blinking. He gives you a very slow, very surprised salute.

puzzles.title: Power Down
puzzles.prompt: Doctor Dilemma is clanking up and down in front of the roof hatch. There's an empty socket on his back, just the right size for a support-class power-down gadget.
hints: You've got a battery pack and a gadget casing with a battery-shaped hole.
Click the battery pack into the casing, then plug the gadget into the robot's back.
puzzles.solvedText: You plug the gadget in. Doctor Dilemma's eyes fade from red to sleepy blue, and he sits down with a yawn: 'Power... down... mode...' A card pops out of a slot in his chest: HATCH ACCESS.

puzzles.title: The Roof Hatch
puzzles.prompt: The roof hatch needs the access card AND a 3-digit code. Captain Comet's voice crackles: 'Dummies in the rescue zone, then gadgets on the dock, then trophies in the cabinet!'
pieces: You counted the training dummies in the rescue zone: 6.
You counted the gadgets on the charging dock: 4.
You counted the trophies in the cabinet: 8.
hints: Three phones remember three numbers. Put them in the order Captain Comet said.
Dummies, then gadgets, then trophies.
puzzles.solvedText: The hatch swings open onto blue sky and a cheering crowd. Captain Comet strikes his biggest pose yet: 'EXAM... PASSED!'

pieces: You counted the training dummies in the rescue zone: 2.
You counted the gadgets on the charging dock: 7.
You counted the trophies in the cabinet: 9.
You counted the training dummies in the rescue zone: 5.
You counted the gadgets on the charging dock: 3.
You counted the trophies in the cabinet: 1.

items.name: Support-gear case
items.description: A silver case from the support class, stamped PROPERTY OF SKYLINE ACADEMY. Something inside clinks.
items.inspect: You open the case. Inside, in a nest of foam: a pair of X-ray goggles! Through them, you can see inside things.

items.name: X-ray goggles
items.description: Chunky goggles with green lenses. Through them, you can see inside lockers, boxes and walls.

items.name: Power gloves
items.description: Chunky silver gloves that hum. With them on, you can lift anything.

items.name: Exam licence
items.description: Your class's exam licence card, a bit squashed from being under a vending machine.

items.name: Glowing battery pack
items.description: A battery pack from the support class. It glows a friendly blue.

items.name: Lightning key
items.description: A big iron key with a lightning bolt on the handle.

items.name: Gadget casing
items.description: An empty gadget with a battery-shaped hole and a label: POWER-DOWN GADGET.

items.name: Power-down gadget
items.description: The casing with its battery clicked in. One press, and any robot takes a nap.

items.name: Hatch access card
items.description: A card that popped out of Doctor Dilemma's chest: HATCH ACCESS.

items.name: Fake moustache
items.description: A curly villain moustache. It doesn't open anything, but it does look fabulous.

recipes.text: The battery pack clicks into the casing and the gadget beeps: READY.
